description.en: Audio format. Only **wav** and **mp3** formats are supported.

description.zh:
语料标识，由用户自定义，支持英文字母和数字，长度为1~32个字符，项目下保证唯一。

建议将语料语义的拼音首字母设置为语料标识，例如：`支付到账`设置为`ZFDZ`。
description.en:
Custom identifier for the speech content. It must consist of English letters and digits, be 1 to 32 characters in length, and be unique within the project.

It is recommended to use the initials of the pinyin representation of the speech semantics as the identifier. For example, use `ZFDZ` for `支付到账` (Payment Received).

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页签，查看当前实例的ID。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** tab in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify this **ID**. Otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
促销活动ID。

调用接口**CreateSharePromotionActivity**返回的**Data**值。
description.en:
The ID of the promotional activity.  

This value is the **Data** field returned by the **CreateSharePromotionActivity** API.

description.zh:
分享任务的分享码。

分享任务的分享码信息，请参见[使用共享设备播报分享语料](~~607661~~)。
description.en:
The share code of the sharing job.  

For information about the share code of a sharing job, see [Broadcast Shared Speech Content on Shared Devices](~~607661~~).

description.zh: 语料类型，仅支持取值目前只支持固定值**custom**，表示自定义语料。
description.en: The type of speech content. Only the static field **custom** is supported, which indicates custom speech content.
Speech rate. Valid values range from -500 to 500.

description.zh: 语料文本，支持英文字母、汉字和空格，长度为1~100个字符，一个汉字占两个字符。
description.en: The text of the speech content. It can contain English letters, Chinese characters, and spaces. The length must be 1 to 100 characters. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: 语料播报声音，由系统预设，例如标准女声、标准男声等。可以选择的声音类型通过[GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~)进行查询，填入返回参数中**VoiceList**中**Value**的值。
description.en: Voice used for speech synthesis, predefined by the system, such as Standard Female Voice or Standard Male Voice. You can query available voice types by calling [GetSpeechVoice](~~217887~~) and use the **Value** field from the **VoiceList** in the response.
The volume level. Valid values: 0 to 100.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
促销活动使用的详细说明，请参见[CreateSharePromotionActivity](~~2568449~~)接口文档的“使用说明”。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
For detailed instructions on using promotional activities, see the "How-To" section in the documentation for the [CreateSharePromotionActivity](~~2568449~~) API.  

## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 per Alibaba Cloud account.  

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of that Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-share-promotion-speech-model --voice Xiaoyun --share-promotion-activity-id 61000000_0000_4901_0000_4700000000000 --speech-model-type custom --iot-instance-id iot-cv300000000 --biz-code ZFDZ --speech-rate 0 --audio-format wav --volume 50 --share-task-code 52000000_700e_4003_900e_610000000000 --text test --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
